**TOP NEWS**
**Ken Paxton finalizes divorce from state Sen. Angela Paxton days after his U.S. Senate loss**
Outgoing Attorney General Ken Paxton's nearly 40-year marriage to state Sen. Angela Paxton ended this week, according to his attorney and reporting from The New York Times. Angela Paxton, R-McKinney, filed in July 2025 on "biblical grounds," citing recent discoveries; the couple had not lived together since mid-2024. Terms remain private. The personal issues featured heavily in the Senate race that Democrat James Talarico won by double digits on Nov. 3. ([KERA](https://substack.com/redirect/d1fc3de3-bfe9-4b69-91b8-6c02121a8993?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [USA Today](https://substack.com/redirect/069f274c-149d-4b0f-873d-f7c197b63549?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Chron](https://substack.com/redirect/728e8212-58e4-44f2-83a8-382247f8f9c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [The Hill](https://substack.com/redirect/edb49069-1f55-4694-a001-802b96bd114e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Democrats chart course for 2027 session after historic sweep; House majority projected**
Democrats won every statewide executive race on Nov. 3 (governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, comptroller, land commissioner, agriculture commissioner, railroad commissioner) for the first time since the early 1990s, plus the U.S. Senate (Talarico over Paxton) and a projected Texas House majority (roughly 83-67 after flipping about 21 seats). Republicans retain the Senate (19-12). Bill filing is underway for the January 2027 session. Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa (first Latina governor; first Democrat since Ann Richards) is assembling a transition team and has pledged early action on education, including reviewing the school voucher/education savings account program. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/cbb4af62-6731-4a0c-9db4-b6359910cc07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/9785e056-e20e-4168-ac78-be77de2870b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Reuters](https://substack.com/redirect/f314b508-841a-42ba-85d4-c74e96a06f16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/3ab6f73d-927f-4437-957b-7faf96025062?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Parents of students with disabilities and voucher advocates watch Hinojosa plans closely**
More than 18,800 students with disabilities currently use the state's education savings accounts. Democrats have vowed to end or defund the program; Hinojosa has line-item veto authority over funding even if full repeal requires legislation. Senate confirmation of a new Education Commissioner (she has pledged to replace Mike Morath) faces hurdles with a Republican Senate majority. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/ded512b7-1fb6-4596-a406-bfe82c05a356?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Talarico stresses bipartisanship as Hinojosa sets Jan. 19 inauguration**
Talarico has emphasized unity in early comments. Hinojosa's inauguration is set for Jan. 19. Nathan Johnson (attorney general-elect) has said he will review ongoing Paxton-era investigations and lawsuits. Comptroller-elect Sarah Eckhardt has sought early input on the revenue estimate. Four women are expected to lead major statewide offices for the first time. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/7b5e7b0d-ae78-47be-933b-3c6326f9374c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Statewide Democratic wins reverse recent South Texas gains by Republicans**
James Talarico carried most predominantly Hispanic South Texas counties by large margins, including Hidalgo County by 46 points after Trump had won it by 3 in 2024. Similar swings appeared in Cameron County. Analysts noted the results erased multiple cycles of Republican gains with Latino voters. ([CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/9785e056-e20e-4168-ac78-be77de2870b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Washington Post](https://substack.com/redirect/3ab6f73d-927f-4437-957b-7faf96025062?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

**STATE GOVERNMENT / #TXLEGE**
**Democrats set to control Texas House; Senfronia Thompson seeks speaker**
Democrats will control the House and elect the speaker (Rep. Senfronia Thompson of Houston has announced a bid and claimed majority support). The Republican Senate remains a check. Proposals already circulating include expanding Medicaid, marijuana legalization, abortion changes, data-center limits, and property-tax measures. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/fed1fbbf-4695-4d70-8b2a-65c9c146bb0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/ee636291-f62c-40f9-b4dd-070227173904?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**More than 1,200 bills filed as lawmakers outline 2027 priorities**
Lawmakers filed more than 1,200 bills in the opening days of the pre-filing period, with the bulk from the new Democratic House majority. Priorities include expanding Medicaid eligibility under the ACA, repealing the $1 billion education savings account program, ending sales-tax exemptions for data centers, legalizing adult-use marijuana, and rolling back certain border-security and immigration statutes. Republicans have filed measures focused on further property-tax relief and restrictions on local-government lobbying. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/fed1fbbf-4695-4d70-8b2a-65c9c146bb0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/0bd1e265-512d-4f79-8614-3ae356fd36bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [KERA](https://substack.com/redirect/28c924bd-9213-448f-8b35-cd3df3fdd65a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [NBC DFW](https://substack.com/redirect/522e5e29-634f-4f8f-a5ac-2ae7148c2346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Divided Legislature convenes Jan. 12 under Democratic governor and House**
The 90th Legislature convenes Jan. 12. With a Democratic governor, Democratic House, and Republican Senate (led by Lt. Gov.-elect Vikki Goodwin), most major legislation will require cross-chamber compromise. Goodwin has signaled interest in THC regulation short of a full ban, clean-water issues, and affordable housing. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/ded512b7-1fb6-4596-a406-bfe82c05a356?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [USA Today](https://substack.com/redirect/b21bffb1-81a1-4962-8fc7-33e7b1cb6f54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Johnson and Eckhardt prepare to take AG and comptroller posts**
Attorney General-elect Nathan Johnson (Dallas Democrat) will succeed Paxton and has indicated he will examine ongoing litigation and investigations from the prior administration. Comptroller-elect Sarah Eckhardt (Austin Democrat) will oversee revenue estimates, tax collections, and the education savings account program and has pledged scrutiny of the latter. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/e263f3da-00a1-4788-916d-d0c7f7e8561e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/c997bfa4-b3ee-4675-a130-21e4de3122c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/7b5e7b0d-ae78-47be-933b-3c6326f9374c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Medicaid expansion, data centers and school vouchers among early bill topics**
Multiple measures address Medicaid expansion under the Affordable Care Act. Others target the education savings account program for repeal and seek greater oversight or tax changes for data centers. Some Republican filings focus on property-tax relief and limits on local lobbying. ([NBC DFW](https://substack.com/redirect/522e5e29-634f-4f8f-a5ac-2ae7148c2346?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/fed1fbbf-4695-4d70-8b2a-65c9c146bb0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

**LOCAL GOVERNMENT**
**Austin voters approve $295 million parks and libraries bond package**
Austin voters approved a $295 million bond package on Nov. 3: Proposition A ($260 million for parks, recreation facilities, trails, and land acquisition) and Proposition B ($35 million for public libraries, including renovations at the Hampton at Oak Hill branch and planning for a Colony Park branch). Both passed with roughly 60% support. Voters also approved seven of ten proposed City Charter amendments, most of them technical. ([City of Austin](https://substack.com/redirect/50cce3bd-61a1-4544-8c5c-79396ae80b66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Austin Free Press](https://substack.com/redirect/2bed16a2-7008-415c-8d5d-c397113835a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Austin Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/6375b4d1-6d29-4b7d-a5a5-3a54ef628171?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Proposition I independent-audit measure fails**
Proposition I, which would have required independent outside audits of city spending every five years and conditioned future tax-rate elections on completed audits, failed with about 44% of the vote. The measure had drawn significant spending and opposition from city-employee unions and most of the current council. ([Austin Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/6375b4d1-6d29-4b7d-a5a5-3a54ef628171?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Texas Scorecard](https://substack.com/redirect/122dbe3c-a80c-4444-ae0f-4aae664f159f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Austin Free Press](https://substack.com/redirect/2bed16a2-7008-415c-8d5d-c397113835a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Austin City Council results force three December runoffs**
City Council results were mixed. District 8 open-seat candidate Selena Xie won outright (roughly 64%). District 9 incumbent Zohaib "Zo" Qadri narrowly cleared 50%. Incumbents Jose Velasquez (District 3) and Ryan Alter (District 5) advanced to Dec. 12 runoffs against Neha Shah and David Weinberg, respectively. District 1 (open seat) is also in a runoff between Amber Goodwin and Misael Ramos. ([Austin Free Press](https://substack.com/redirect/2bed16a2-7008-415c-8d5d-c397113835a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Austin Bulldog](https://substack.com/redirect/972591f1-5529-4248-842a-1fb3fa209e52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Ballotpedia](https://substack.com/redirect/5dd0b510-260c-4c41-8b2b-06d310db3fe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Proposed Congress Avenue tower seeks zoning for up to 1,200 feet**
A rezoning request is pending for a proposed Congress Avenue project ("Project Bolo") that would allow a hotel/condo tower up to 1,200 feet--potentially taller than the current Waterline. The application seeks density-bonus zoning in exchange for community benefits. ([Austin American-Statesman](https://substack.com/redirect/fb69c003-11ef-4238-8f75-98be64283bc2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**City Council to canvass election results and order runoffs this week**
Austin City Council agendas include resolutions canvassing the Nov. 3 bond and general election results and ordering a Dec. 12 runoff for Districts 1, 3 and 5. A work session is also scheduled. ([City of Austin](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca2c044-0fbf-4938-8a11-c9a8363c68df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [City of Austin](https://substack.com/redirect/be0f7d24-0755-4f16-940d-e4e6b4e64687?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
* * *
**TEXANS IN WASHINGTON (ADMINISTRATION / U.S. CONGRESS)**
**James Talarico wins Texas Senate seat by double digits**
James Talarico's double-digit Senate victory ends decades of Republican control of the seat and pairs him with Ted Cruz in the Texas delegation beginning in January. Early post-election comments from Talarico have stressed bipartisanship. ([CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/9785e056-e20e-4168-ac78-be77de2870b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Reuters](https://substack.com/redirect/f314b508-841a-42ba-85d4-c74e96a06f16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/ded512b7-1fb6-4596-a406-bfe82c05a356?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**GOP mid-decade redistricting backfires; delegation set for 24-14 split**
Republicans' 2025 mid-decade congressional redistricting, intended to produce a 30-8 GOP majority in the Texas House delegation, largely backfired. Democrats held or flipped most targeted seats; the projected result is 24 Republicans and 14 Democrats--one net Democratic gain from the prior map. Notable outcomes include Bobby Pulido defeating incumbent Monica De La Cruz in TX-15 and Katy Padilla Stout defeating Brandon Herrera in TX-23. South Texas Democratic incumbents Henry Cuellar and Vicente Gonzalez also held on. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b15024a5-42ac-4e19-9853-39243dd5a494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/7b5ce9ea-5b63-436f-afe8-eb347d3a3242?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Houston-area delegation includes multiple freshmen after midterms**
Half of Houston's 10 U.S. House seats will be held by freshmen. Democrats held their seats despite the new map; Republicans retained six. Statewide, the outcome left Republicans with one fewer seat than at the start of the prior Congress. ([Houston Chronicle](https://substack.com/redirect/7b5ce9ea-5b63-436f-afe8-eb347d3a3242?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b15024a5-42ac-4e19-9853-39243dd5a494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**New map used after earlier court challenges; national House implications limited**
The new map was used for the 2026 elections after earlier court challenges. National implications include a smaller-than-hoped Republican gain in the U.S. House from Texas, one of the largest states. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b15024a5-42ac-4e19-9853-39243dd5a494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Ted Cruz remains as Texas ' senior senator alongside Talarico**
With Cornyn's seat flipping, Ted Cruz becomes the state's senior senator when the new Congress convenes. The delegation shifts from 25 Republicans and 13 Democrats to a projected 24-14 split. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/b15024a5-42ac-4e19-9853-39243dd5a494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

**BUSINESS NEWS**
**NRC greenlights first advanced nuclear project at U.S. industrial site in Texas**
Federal regulators issued a construction permit for the first advanced nuclear facility at a U.S. industrial site: four X-energy Xe-100 small modular reactors (up to 320 MW electric plus process heat) at Dow's Seadrift Operations complex on the Gulf Coast. The Long Mott Generating Station is a Department of Energy Advanced Reactor Demonstration Program project; construction could begin later this decade if Dow proceeds, with power possible in the early 2030s. ([Department of Energy](https://substack.com/redirect/b13e4194-9aa6-406c-8124-4d8bd6fc1e7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Inside Climate News](https://substack.com/redirect/625032bf-5d90-475a-a5bb-60d742e4ba43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [TechCrunch](https://substack.com/redirect/e87b1f98-1b81-4c9e-a8e6-c7311cf4e1f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**SpaceX seeks tax breaks from Starbase for $24 billion data center and gas plant**
SpaceX is seeking tax abatements from the city of Starbase and Cameron County for a proposed $24 billion data-center and associated natural-gas power plant (roughly 750 MW, 35 turbines) on recently annexed land near the Port of Brownsville. Site preparation has begun; the project has drawn attention amid broader state debate over data-center energy and water use. ([San Antonio Express-News](https://substack.com/redirect/cb3f2b31-475d-49a5-8249-eee7409b71ea?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Data-center bills already filed as lawmakers eye incentives and water use**
Data-center regulation is already a focus of early 2027 bill filings, with measures from both parties addressing tax incentives, water-use disclosure, and local oversight. The sector's rapid growth has become a bipartisan campaign and legislative issue. ([Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/fed1fbbf-4695-4d70-8b2a-65c9c146bb0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Dallas Morning News](https://substack.com/redirect/0bd1e265-512d-4f79-8614-3ae356fd36bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Dow and X-energy project marks several nuclear firsts for the U.S.**
The NRC construction permit is the first for a high-temperature gas-cooled reactor in more than 50 years, the first for a pebble-bed design, and the first advanced reactor approved at an industrial site. Each Xe-100 unit is designed for 80 MW electric or 200 MW thermal. ([Department of Energy](https://substack.com/redirect/b13e4194-9aa6-406c-8124-4d8bd6fc1e7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [Inside Climate News](https://substack.com/redirect/625032bf-5d90-475a-a5bb-60d742e4ba43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

**November 16, 2026**
There is a time each year when bees arrive in my backyard, drawn to the blossoms of a flowering tree. Their presence fills me with a sense of abundance. Knowing they can find nourishment here is a reminder of the simple generosity of the natural world.
As the holidays approach, my thoughts turn to the kitchen table--the center of our sustenance and community. I think of families whose tables may not hold a holiday spread, and those who struggle to provide even an ordinary meal.
With proposed changes to SNAP eligibility under consideration, the landscape of food security is shifting, adding a quiet weight to these seasonal reflections.

There is a threshold between the garden's plenty and the empty table.
**Pause.
Breathe.
Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

#### **The Favor Scam**
## **The holiday text that talks you into buying gift cards for a stranger**
_A friendly question lands on your phone, a boss or a pastor needs a small favor, and the money is gone before you sense the trap. It peaks in December._
Scammers do not take the holidays off. They treat them as prime season, and the script starts gently. A text asks whether you have a minute, whether you are still on for lunch, or simply [can you do me a favor](https://theeagledispatch.podia.com/p/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJuZXdzbGV0dGVyX2xpbmtfaWQiOjQ2MzkwNTd9.TL43plT5XEotPxIdAJxtRyU_T9e2YVDBVsrQzmN4yuc/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdHVkZW50X2lkIjo2NjAzOTM5OSwibmV3c2xldHRlcl9pZCI6MzMyMDgyMn0.sjzfdEnUaqbBJCNYOWtciXSoSzis8nWK105IR8tdAzw). Soon a familiar voice, a boss traveling for work or a pastor helping a struggling family, needs you to go buy gift cards and read back the codes. The instant you do, it is gone for good.
---
The losses are climbing fast. Consumers reported [$154 million drained through gift cards](https://theeagledispatch.podia.com/p/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJuZXdzbGV0dGVyX2xpbmtfaWQiOjQ2MzkwNTh9.EP9WKnepMCNn3LgKMVBVQ-4kD3FijOJXhhTAA9ACBkM/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdHVkZW50X2lkIjo2NjAzOTM5OSwibmV3c2xldHRlcl9pZCI6MzMyMDgyMn0.sjzfdEnUaqbBJCNYOWtciXSoSzis8nWK105IR8tdAzw) in just the first six months of 2026, and the pace only quickens into the holidays. Gift cards are the favorite tool for a plain reason: once the codes are read aloud, the cash is as good as handed over.
One rule defeats nearly all of it. No real employer, agency, or utility will ever ask to be paid in gift cards.
If a message pushes urgency and steers you toward a gift-card rack, that is the tell. A newer twist is sneakier still: thieves copy the card numbers and PINs right off the store display, then drain the balance the moment you activate it, so check the packaging before you buy. I treat every out-of-the-blue favor text as a stranger until it proves otherwise.

I’m talking about a radical new form of AI I call “M.A.G.I.”

[](https://theeagledispatch.podia.com/p/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJuZXdzbGV0dGVyX2xpbmtfaWQiOjQ2MzkwNjF9.8bRBMPTP9JrtT2gLJDhssHpuQH9JWNfr9toaFO1_lZI/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdHVkZW50X2lkIjo2NjAzOTM5OSwibmV3c2xldHRlcl9pZCI6MzMyMDgyMn0.sjzfdEnUaqbBJCNYOWtciXSoSzis8nWK105IR8tdAzw)

But then again... everything Elon has ever done sounded insane at first.
Self-driving cars.

#### **The Trillion-Dollar Season**
## **Americans will spend more than ever this holiday, while feeling worse about it**
Retailers expect a record haul even as shoppers say they are nervous. That gap between what people spend and how they feel is the real story of this season.
---
▪ The National Retail Federation projects holiday sales will top [$1 trillion for the first time](https://theeagledispatch.podia.com/p/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJuZXdzbGV0dGVyX2xpbmtfaWQiOjQ2MzkwNjR9.4b055r3tuSfp7571DlSetKnuvPPTj5U-iKSYVXCIoto/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdHVkZW50X2lkIjo2NjAzOTM5OSwibmV3c2xldHRlcl9pZCI6MzMyMDgyMn0.sjzfdEnUaqbBJCNYOWtciXSoSzis8nWK105IR8tdAzw), up about 4.2 percent over last year across November and December.
▪ About half of that growth is simply higher prices, not more gifts in the cart. Measured against inflation, the real increase is closer to 2 percent.
▪ Consumer confidence is weak even as the registers ring, a reminder that people often spend out of habit and obligation rather than optimism.
▪ Buy-now-pay-later is spreading fast as a way to stretch the season, which can turn a cheerful December into a tight February.
A record season is good news for the stores. Whether it is good news for a household depends entirely on what is left on the statement come January.
---
#### **One Number**
**$1,960** is what the average person lost after answering a scam text in the first half of 2026, [up 35 percent in a year](https://theeagledispatch.podia.com/p/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJuZXdzbGV0dGVyX2xpbmtfaWQiOjQ2MzkwNjV9.aAHjA48nbUR1awcsMUgvxiOHMDSaAp0vwjXDvPMz4_g/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdHVkZW50X2lkIjo2NjAzOTM5OSwibmV3c2xldHRlcl9pZCI6MzMyMDgyMn0.sjzfdEnUaqbBJCNYOWtciXSoSzis8nWK105IR8tdAzw). That is most of a mortgage payment, gone to a stranger who sounded friendly and familiar. The tools got sharper, not the victims more careless: scammers now lean on artificial intelligence and the personal details people post online to make the con land. A single unanswered text is the cheapest insurance there is.
#### **Why I Led Here**
I led with scams because in eighteen years of planning work, the most painful calls I ever took were never about a bad market. They came from someone who had just realized the money was gone, and that no bank or agency was going to make them whole.
These crooks are patient and polite, and they aim at the very instincts we admire, trust and the urge to help. The defense is not suspicion of everyone. It is a single firm habit: when money or gift cards enter a conversation you did not start, you stop and verify through a number you already had. That one pause has protected more savings than any investment I ever recommended.

### [Former Patient Sues Home Sweet Home Care, Claims Caretakers Couldn't Speak English, Demanded Signed Blank Timesheets](https://substack.com/redirect/312e55da-9002-43e9-9575-aa1c05f01327?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
When we first reported on Gateway Community Services, an ex-employee told us that the Medicaid welfare agency commonly had patients sign blank timecards that could then be forged to bill for hours no one at the agency ever worked. Now, a MaineCare patient has alleged in a personal injury lawsuit that a separate Medicaid agency attempted to pressure them into similarly signing off on blank timesheets. Also at the center of the lawsuit: Did the "caretaker's" lack of English proficiency contribute to the injury?
The plaintiff in the case is suing Home Sweet Home Care, LLC, a licensed personal care agency and MaineCare biller, over a fall in her bathroom in November 2024. Her complaint, filed July 17, 2025, says a care worker put wood furniture polish on the tile floor and never warned her it was slippery. The care worker testified she only ever cleaned floors with water. In a deposition, the woman said the company pressed her to sign timesheets marked out for all seven days of the week before anyone had filled them in. "Anything could be marked on these papers," she said. Her lawyer says the care worker can't speak English or read the warning on the label. Questioned through an interpreter, the worker named Lingala and Portuguese -- the two predominant languages in Angola, from which Maine has received a large population of non-citizens since 2018 -- as the languages she speaks and reads, then said later that she speaks some English and is still learning.
The Maine Wire's Seamus Othot reports the agency's license is active but under review, that it has billed $2,692,922 since 2020, and that its owner, Qamar Ahmed, is opening a second agency, Platinum Home Care, out of the same office. Nobody answered when the Maine Wire called for comment, and the company didn't return a voicemail. A South Portland agency, Community Home Health Care, was [indicted in October](https://substack.com/redirect/c3c25d6d-e68c-465c-bfce-0658204802f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on federal charges that it used its electronic timesheet system to bill for services it never gave. Seamus Othot has the story.

### [Maine Heating Oil Drops to Average $5.84 Per Gallon](https://substack.com/redirect/7472702e-69bb-4f3b-901a-1c8b34a1386a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A little relief at the tank. Libby Palanza has the story, and you can follow the [state's average prices here](https://substack.com/redirect/7a2177ad-4ad6-44f0-a43f-a1dc1d10cfa2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The state's Nov. 9 survey put heating oil at $5.84 a gallon, 20 cents under last month's record of $6.04. Kerosene averaged $6.77 and propane $3.64. Last winter, federal energy figures ranked Maine tenth in the country for residential fuel oil prices and twelfth for propane. The 315,000 barrels the Trump administration let go from the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve last month came out of a stockpile of one million barrels, which the Department of Energy keeps for supply disruptions. Privately, industry leaders in Maine fear that energy prices could nonetheless soar even higher this year, prompting the large Democrat majorities in Augusta to impose heavy-handed government controls. In other words, coming soon: The Maine Heating Oil Authority.
### [Federal Judge Rules Hermon School Committee Violated Pines Church's First Amendment Right, Maine Human Rights Act](https://substack.com/redirect/10366bd8-fc12-428b-bcb6-9b6a675f6b0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Hermon's school committee wouldn't give Pines Church a year-long lease for Sunday services at the high school, and on Friday a federal judge said why. Chief U.S. District Judge Lance Walker found it "more likely than not that discriminatory animus toward the Church" drove the decision, which he ruled violated the First Amendment and the Maine Human Rights Act. Walker's [full ruling is here](https://substack.com/redirect/97b79127-90ac-434d-a64c-1aeed21e7fec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [my Saturday post](https://substack.com/redirect/888978ef-271d-45ea-b94b-a2df6b4ef0e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) has more on McLaughlin's emails.
### [The Groaning Will Continue Until the Choices Change - The Pastor's Office](https://substack.com/redirect/ff0f4ce9-629f-4bd4-9935-ec8c4869fa41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I sat down with Pastor Travis Carey of Calvary Chapel Greater Portland for his show, The Pastor's Office. We opened on a church that said nothing about the election the Sunday after it and went from there: the Republican losses in Maine, why so many young people on the right now keep their views to themselves, the failure of so many liberals to see that policies aimed at reducing human suffering actually cause more suffering, and the video of early voting at Lewiston City Hall that the Maine Wire got with a records request. ### [Turley Keynotes Maine Policy Institute Luncheon as Group Announces Legal Center](https://substack.com/redirect/792da58e-aacf-4568-a941-4aaf19ef9c11?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Starting in 2027, Maine Policy Institute will have lawyers of its own. CEO Matthew Gagnon told Friday's Freedom & Opportunity luncheon at the Holiday Inn By the Bay that the institute will open a legal center to fight government overreach and defend people the government targets. (FYI: The Maine Wire is a project of the institute.) Constitutional scholar Jonathan Turley gave the keynote on free speech and the founding, drawing on his book "Rage and the Republic," and warned against treating opposing opinions as threats. The institute also honored the DiMillo family for their work on Portland's waterfront. That afternoon's ground stop left Turley stuck in town. "There are some obvious benefits to being stranded in Portland Maine with a FAA shutdown," he posted on X.
### [Airlines Cancel More Than 2,000 Flights Saturday After Friday Telecom Outage, Ground Stop](https://substack.com/redirect/0a44940a-0540-4d25-b1cc-a55eb55cdb2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
If your weekend flight disappeared, here's why. Telecommunications trouble at FAA facilities across the country cut into radar data and controller communications Friday afternoon, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, and the FAA held departures for more than four hours. Duffy said more than 3,500 planes were already flying when it started. The ground stop lifted around 8:15 p.m., but airlines canceled more than 2,000 flights Saturday, according to the Associated Press. JetBlue scrubbed the rest of its Friday schedule except some flights to Europe from Boston and JFK. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there's no sign it was a cyberattack, and the investigation is still open. Duffy blamed old equipment that couldn't handle the volume of data and asked Congress for money to replace it.

"There are some obvious benefits to being stranded in Portland Maine with a FAA shutdown," he posted on X. If your weekend flight disappeared, here's why. Telecommunications trouble at FAA facilities across the country cut into radar data and controller communications Friday afternoon, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said, and the FAA held departures for more than four hours. Duffy said more than 3,500 planes were already flying when it started. The ground stop lifted around 8:15 p.m., but airlines canceled more than 2,000 flights Saturday, according to the Associated Press. JetBlue scrubbed the rest of its Friday schedule except some flights to Europe from Boston and JFK. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said there's no sign it was a cyberattack, and the investigation is still open. Duffy blamed old equipment that couldn't handle the volume of data and asked Congress for money to replace it. The Robinson Report is reader-supported. If someone forwarded you this, . It's free. # How to Spot a Phishing Email on iPhone
Everybody gets phishing emails. But sometimes it’s not always easy to determine if an email is from a legitimate email address or if it’s a scam. In this tip, we’ll show you how to verify email addresses on iPhone and easily spot scam emails.
## Why You’ll Love This Tip
* **Check if an email is from a legitimate email address or a scam in the Mail app.**
* **Avoid falling for deceptive phishing scam emails.**

## How to Recognize Phishing Emails in the Mail App
### System Requirements
_This tip was performed on an iPhone 15 Pro running iOS 27. Find out how to update to the[latest version of iOS](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261239-8633139-67e94dd4a9-8q0a2443b7)._A phishing email is an email that appears to come from a legitimate source and prompts you to open a link or call a phone number. If you open that link or call that number, you'll be directed to a scammer who will pretend to be a person of authority and try to convince you to hand over confidential information, like banking details.At this point, scam emails are just a fact of life. Most of the time, phishing scams are sent straight to your spam or junk folder. However, every now and then, one or two will slip through the cracks and show up in your inbox. For more tips like this, be sure to sign up for our free [Tip of the Day](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261239-8633140-f915d07927-8q0a2443b7) newsletter. Signing up for the Tip of the Day also signs you up for our free Security Friday newsletter where we cover the latest news in digital privacy and security and offer tips to stay safe online.Now, if you have a suspicion about an email you received, here’s how to recognize phishing emails in the Mail app:
1. This is a pretty official looking invoice. Start by tapping the **address bar**.

|
---
2. Tap the name in the **From:** **field**. Sometimes, when I receive these types of emails, the scammer will use my own name. It may also appear to be from a familiar business or person or, sometimes, something totally random.

---
3. A new menu will open showing you the email address this message came from (if you are using an earlier version of iOS, you may see a contact card instead). In this case, the email is from a Gmail address. The content of the email was from Best Buy’s Geek Squad, so if this was a legitimate email, it should have come from an @bestbuy.com email address. Therefore, this is a scam email. Even if the email address looks legit at first glance, look carefully to see if there is a typo (e.g. @bestby.com) or a strange top-level domain (@bestbuy.io).

---

4. The email is claiming I purchased a product from Geek Squad and the amount owed is $389.99. This is an alarming amount of money meant to make you panic and call the number indicated in the email right away. If you are in doubt as to whether the email is legitimate, don't call the number in the email or respond directly to the email. Go to the business's website instead, and find out how to contact customer service directly. Do NOT click any links in the email. Open a web browser and type in the address for the business's website.

---
5. However, a dead giveaway for this particular email is that the quantity listed is 928. I'm no math expert but unless the product I bought costs 42 cents each, $389.99 seems like an abnormally low cost for almost one thousand products.

---
6. Another telltale sign is that in the body of the email, “Geek Squad” provides a phone number for you to call if you need assistance. You can search the web for the number given to see if it traces back to a legitimate source if you're ever in doubt.

---
7. If a physical address is provided at the bottom of the email, you can also check that.

---
8. I long pressed on the address and an Apple Maps window popped out. This looks like a random street in California, not a Best Buy store or even a corporate headquarters.

---
9. Let's take a look at another type of email. This one is an Apple ID sign in alert. I don't own an iPhone 15 Pro Max and I don't recall signing into my account on August 6th. Additionally, the email is from "Apple support." This looks concerning at first glance. I'm going to tap the address bar just like we did in [step 1](href=).

---
10. Tap the name "Apple Support" in the **From:** **field**.

---
11. Look at that crazy email address. Sign-in alerts from Apple originate from an @email.apple.com address.

---
12. Generally, I would not recommend tapping any links in this email. For demonstrative purposes, I'm going to long-press this link to show you what happens.

---
13. The link leads to what looks like an official Apple Account sign-in page. Except the URL is a .pages.dev domain. This is not Apple.com or iCloud.com.

---

Now you know a few different ways to tell if an email is a scam. Next, find out how to [manage sharing and access on your iPhone](https://click.iphonelife.com/ga/click/2-17209627-5-0-261239-8633141-1b56820534-8q0a2443b7).

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Hi,

It’s Jocelyn. I wanted to make sure you saw my team’s message from last
week.

We have a very important question: What do you want to see from Michigan’s
next governor?

I’ve always firmly believed public service works best when leaders take
the time to listen to the people they represent. Whether it’s listening to
people’s frustrations, their concerns, or their hopes for the future, all
of it is a crucial part of the job, and informs how the government can
work better for the people it serves.

It’s how I approached this campaign, it’s how I approach my work as
Secretary of State, and it’s how I’ll approach our fight as your
Governor-Elect.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1001&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]That’s why I’m asking you to please take a minute or two to fill out
our Pre-Inauguration Priorities Survey. I promise it won’t take
long. I’d
really appreciate your thoughts.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1002&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]Take the Survey →

Thank you,
— Jocelyn Benson 💜

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1003&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ][IMG]

To: [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1004&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]dpwillis67@gmail.com
From: Jocelyn Benson HQ
Subject: Now, the hard work begins.

Hi there,

It’s Team Benson, and we wanted to reach out before you log off for the
weekend with an important question: What do you want to see from
Michigan’s next governor?

With less than 50 days until Jocelyn is inaugurated as Michigan’s 50th
governor, we want to hear what issues are on your mind, what you think are
the most pressing problems Michigan is facing, and the solutions you would
like to see from your governor. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1005&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]Will you please take a moment today and
fill out our Pre-Inauguration Priorities Survey?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1006&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]Weigh In →

Our historic win last Tuesday didn’t happen by luck. It was the result of
over a year of hard work from thousands of
supporters
just like you knocking doors, calling their neighbors, or chipping in a
buck or two, because they believed in the Michigan we were fighting for.

Now, the hard work begins.

It’s time to build that Michigan. The only way we can make a Michigan
where everyone can stay and thrive is by centering the issues affecting
everyday Michiganders.

Jocelyn has spent her entire career ensuring that every voice, every vote,
and every opinion has the right to be heard, counted, and respected.
That’s the exact kind of leadership she will bring to the governor’s
office — but the only way is if we hear from you.

That’s why we’re asking you to please fill out our Pre-Inauguration
Priorities Survey today and let us know your thoughts. It will take less
than a minute of your time, but goes a long way in delivering real results
for Michiganders.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/survey/111326_survey?refcode=email_111626_surveyfwd&t=1007&akid=2152%2E181023%2ErfUsib ]Take the Survey →

Team Benson

**Monday, November 16, 2026 - **
_**Iran:** Iran claims six-drone strike on U.S. radar system in Bahrain. U.S. deploys third aircraft carrier to Middle East. Six oil tankers struck mines, caught fire in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says. IRGC claims capture of eighth intact U.S. drone in Hormuz. Israel reportedly warns U.S. of Iranian drone plot targeting President Donald Trump; Tehran denounces "disinformation." Bahrain sentences convicts 69 defendants over alleged ties to Iran, confiscates $21.2 million._
_**Palestine:** Israeli forces kill one Palestinian, wound five others across Gaza. Israeli forces detain 13 Palestinians in occupied West Bank raids. Palestinian prisoners suffer severe weight loss and scabies in Israeli prison. Australia, Canada, UK, and Italy demand Israel allow 150,000 tents into Gaza amid deadly winter storms. Guardian: Israeli uploaded millions of photos of Palestinians to Amazon's facial recognition platform. Palestinian lawmaker elected deputy speaker of Israeli Knesset._
_**Yemen:** Ansarallah seizes over 2,000 square kilometers in southern Yemen, takes control of Bab al-Mandab front. Three Yemenis, including child, killed in strikes on Sana'a and Amran. Ansarallah claims strikes on Riyadh airport, financial center, and Saudi oil pipeline. Ansarallah releases 600 detainees in Sana'a, bringing unilateral releases to 2,612. Armed men approach oil tanker east of Yemen's Socotra island._
_**Lebanon:** Israeli forces abduct two Lebanese brothers in Shebaa, strike southern Lebanon despite ceasefire. Israel strikes Syria-Lebanon border, claims weapons shipment destined for Hezbollah._
_**U.S.:** Van Hollen accuses Schumer of attempting to rush Senate election. Senate permitting reform, energy bill headed for final passage. U.S. loses measles elimination status. Alaska continues counting votes, with Peltola increasing her lead over Sullivan. Trump's portfolio likely held $13 million to $62 million in Nvidia stock as of August, the Washington Post finds. International student enrollment falls at U.S. colleges. Incoming Rep. Don Leonard backing Ayanna Pressley. Federal prosecutor accuses Warren of preparing "to target private individuals close to" Trump and orders her to preserve documents. Transportation Sec. Duffy declines to apologize for Friday's nationwide ground stop._
_**International:** UAE remains major hub for gold smuggled from war zones despite new regulations. Saudi Arabia executes two men. Imran Khan details inhumane treatment, asks for urgent medical care in letter to justices. About 4.5 million people have returned to Sudan, UNHCR says. Africa CDC says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is still not under control. Somaliland's intelligence agency says it briefly detained five U.S. nationals it accused of threatening national security. Ecuador's President Noboa denies the U.S. has a military base near Guayaquil. Guatemala decrees a 30-day state of emergency in its eastern provinces after lawmakers killed. Mexican journalist found dead in Guerrero. Martine Moise, widow of Haiti's assassinated president Jovenel Moise, registers as a presidential candidate._

# Iran
* **Iran claims six-drone strike on U.S. radar system in Bahrain:** Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) [said](https://substack.com/redirect/15ae235c-c8da-4b35-ab7e-d9462033be79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday that it launched six drones successfully targeting a U.S. air defense radar system at Bahrain's Al-Rifaa helicopter base, describing the operation as the second phase of its response to U.S. military actions in the Strait of Hormuz. Bahrain's military, however, said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed the Iranian attacks before they reached their targets.
* The strikes followed an earlier Iranian drone attack on Bahrain on Friday, the first targeting a Gulf country since September, when the IRGC also claimed to have destroyed a U.S. early-warning radar system.
* **U.S. deploys third aircraft carrier to Middle East:** The United States deployed a third aircraft carrier strike group to the Middle East amid heightened tensions with Iran. The USS Theodore Roosevelt entered the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility on Sunday, joining the USS George Washington and USS George H.W. Bush.
* Meanwhile, the European Union Aviation Safety Agency extended its warnings for airlines operating in Middle Eastern airspace until January 31, citing continued risks from the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran. The advisory covers Iran, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Lebanon, Iraq, and the wider Gulf region.
* **Six oil tankers struck mines, caught fire in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says:** Iran's IRGC Navy [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/f79d5990-9f83-450a-b25f-df690921e2f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday that two more oil tankers struck naval mines overnight while attempting to cross the Strait of Hormuz through a "prohibited" southern route, triggering explosions and fires. The IRGC claimed the vessels were operating under U.S. military guidance, bringing the number of tankers it claims to have sunk since Sunday to six.
* Iran's regular navy reported that another tanker caught fire after striking a mine east of the strait. The reports have not been independently verified.
* Separately, UK Maritime Trade Operations reported Monday that a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile while transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz, sparking a fire in its engine room. All crew members were accounted for, while the extent of the damage and environmental impact remain unknown.
* **IRGC claims capture of eighth intact U.S. drone in Hormuz:** The IRGC Navy [said](https://substack.com/redirect/12555ac1-bb33-4cb0-855f-098edeab31eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday that it forced a U.S. MQM-170 drone to land intact using electronic warfare systems in the Strait of Hormuz. The IRGC said it was the fourth MQM-170 and the eighth U.S. drone captured intact by its forces in the strait. The force also claimed to have intercepted, captured, or destroyed several other types of U.S. drones, including MQ-9s, MQ-1s, and LUCAS attack drones, since the start of the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran.
* **Israel reportedly warns U.S. of Iranian drone plot targeting Trump; Tehran denounces "disinformation": **Israel's Mossad intelligence agency provided the CIA with information suggesting Iran was planning drone attacks targeting President Donald Trump and senior administration officials, Israel Hayom reported Saturday. The newspaper said the warnings prompted heightened security in Washington, including the relocation of some officials to protected facilities and a reduction in Trump's public appearances.
* Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said U.S. officials receive "aspirational threats from Iran" daily, adding that Washington was already aware of the threats and was prepared to respond.
* Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei rejected the allegations, accusing Israel of orchestrating a disinformation campaign to build Western public support for escalating the war. "Fear must be manufactured to push the public into backing an escalation of the war," he said.
* **Bahrain sentences convicts 69 defendants over alleged ties to Iran, confiscates $21.2 million:** A Bahraini court on Monday [sentenced](https://substack.com/redirect/75ee915a-334f-458a-a123-e8c40bfc455b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 64 defendants to life imprisonment and five others to 15 years in prison over accusations of establishing a group linked to Iran's IRGC and seeking to overthrow the government, according to the Britain-based Bahrain Institute for Rights and Democracy. Bahrain's public prosecution [said](https://substack.com/redirect/ebfc16b3-076d-4257-9892-d108ec8637bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the court also ordered the confiscation of more than $21.2 million and imposed fines of approximately $265,000 on some defendants.

# Palestine
* **Israeli forces kill one Palestinian, wound five others across Gaza:** A young Palestinian man was [shot and killed](https://substack.com/redirect/8150f770-c073-4440-804a-62bb2887e2fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Israeli forces in the Al-Qassasib neighborhood of Jabalia, northern Gaza, on Monday, according to WAFA. Two other Palestinians sustained gunshot wounds in the nearby town of Beit Lahia.
* In southern Gaza, Israeli forces shot and wounded three Palestinians, including a child, inside a school south of Khan Younis.
* **Israeli forces detain 13 Palestinians in occupied West Bank raids:**
* **Hebron:** Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/9553ea2c-a727-425d-86a0-1dad63a185ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 11 Palestinians, including journalist Yasser Jaradat, during a raid on Sa'ir, on Monday, according to WAFA. In nearby Al-Shuyukh, soldiers closed the town's entrance, seized vehicles, and turned homes into military posts. Schools in both towns suspended classes due to the military presence.
* **Jenin:** Israeli forces [detained](https://substack.com/redirect/81d19903-4eea-4d02-8f8c-5327367a1ed4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two Palestinians after raiding their homes in Jenin city. Soldiers also raided Al-Fandaqumiya, Burqin, and Rummana, firing tear gas in the latter and causing several cases of suffocation. On Sunday, an Israeli military jeep ran over two Palestinians riding a motorcycle east of Jenin, leaving one with a broken foot and the other with a head injury, according to the Palestine Red Crescent Society.
* **Nablus:** Israeli forces raided Beit Furik, east of Nablus, and Beita, south of the city. In Beit Furik, soldiers stormed several businesses, destroyed equipment in one shop, and assaulted residents, according to WAFA. In Beita, Israeli forces entered Palestinian homes and fired live ammunition and tear gas canisters.
* **Tubas:** Israeli settlers [fired](https://substack.com/redirect/cee9f6e6-81cf-490e-9253-e36a32941712?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) live ammunition toward Palestinian herders in northern Yarza, east of Tubas, forcing them to abandon grazing areas.
* **Palestinian prisoners suffer severe weight loss and scabies in Israeli prison:** Palestinian prisoners held at Israel's Naqab Prison are suffering deteriorating health conditions amid medical neglect, poor sanitation, and a lack of treatment, the Palestinian Commission of Detainees and Ex-Detainees Affairs reported Monday. Mustafa Abu Al-Fiya, 39, from Tulkarm, suffers from spinal disc problems and heart disease and has lost approximately 14 kilograms without receiving necessary medical care. Qais Al-Habal, 25, from west of Ramallah, has lost 39 kilograms, and suffers from severe scabies and boils. Two other prisoners from Jerusalem are also suffering from scabies.
* **Australia, Canada, UK, and Italy urge Israel to allow 150,000 tents into Gaza amid deadly winter storms:** The foreign ministers of Australia, Canada, the UK, and Italy [issued](https://substack.com/redirect/3b8cb2cb-3bd6-4b2d-a127-3090d4a1d836?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a joint statement Monday urging Israel to immediately allow 150,000 tents and other essential supplies held at the border into Gaza, warning that the humanitarian situation is "dire" as winter storms devastate displacement camps. "The crossings must be opened, and the tents allowed in," the ministers said without threatening any repercussions or sanctions, calling for "immediate, rapid and unimpeded humanitarian access." Recent flooding has damaged or submerged tens of thousands of tents, while at least four children and a woman have been killed.
* **Guardian: Israel uploaded millions of photos of Palestinians to Amazon 's facial recognition platform:** The Israeli military uploaded 3.5 million photos to Amazon's cloud platform in order to use the company's facial recognition technology to analyze images of Palestinians, according to an [exclusive report](https://substack.com/redirect/7f4baf97-01bb-481b-95b9-06a928529286?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Guardian.
* The vast catalogue of images was moved into Amazon's cloud in the early months of the Israeli genocide in Gaza that began in October 2023. The large set of images was moved into an Amazon data center near Tel Aviv.
* The Israeli military informed Amazon of the decision to upload the images in early 2024 so it could use Rekognition, Amazon's AI-powered image analysis platform.
* An Israeli military source told the Guardian that Amazon's cloud infrastructure was used due to the "very large scale" of images collected at checkpoints in Gaza that Palestinians were made to pass through after being forcibly displaced by the Israeli assault.
* **Palestinian lawmaker elected deputy speaker of Israeli Knesset:** Ahmed Tibi, chairman of the Joint List faction and leader of the Ta'al Party, has been elected deputy speaker of Israel's parliament, the Knesset. His appointment follows historic gains by parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel in last month's elections, with the Joint List and United Arab List (Ra'am) securing a combined 19 seats.

# Yemen
* **Ansarallah seizes over 2,000 square kilometers in southern Yemen, takes control of Bab al-Mandab front:** Ansarallah [captured](https://substack.com/redirect/e1b02e14-1025-41d9-8be9-b73660e0f2bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over 2,000 square kilometers of the Al-Madaribah Wa Ras Al-Arah district of the Lahij governorate in a single day with its forces now controlling all of the Bab Al-Mandab front.
* The Ansarallah offensive in Lahij Governorate in southern Yemen effectively encircled the remaining forces loyal to the Saudi-backed Presidential Leadership Council in the Bab al-Mandab area on Sunday.
* Ansarallah forces reached Al-Kharaz camp at the southern foot of Jabal Kharaz in the Al-Madaribah Wa Ras Al-Arah district and established fire control over the last remaining road out of Bab al-Mandab.
* Saudi-backed forces said they are withdrawing from positions overlooking the strait to reinforce defenses around their interim capital, Aden.
* The UN Refugee Agency warned that fighting is approaching a displacement camp housing 9,600 people in Lahij governorate.
* **Three Yemenis, including child, killed in strikes on Sana 'a and Amran: **Three Yemenis, including a child, were killed and 15 others wounded in separate strikes on Ansarallah-controlled areas of Yemen on Monday, according to the Associated Press citing health authorities. A drone strike on a home in the Al-Sarar neighborhood of Sana'a killed a child and wounded seven people, while airstrikes on a privately owned fuel station in Harf Sufian district of Amran governorate killed two people and wounded eight others. Ansarallah blamed Saudi Arabia for the attacks.
* **Ansarallah claims strikes on Riyadh airport, financial center, and Saudi oil pipeline:** Ansarallah [launched](https://substack.com/redirect/77c94ed9-e15d-45c2-9381-852f4fe8bb61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two ballistic missiles targeting King Khalid International Airport and a financial center in the Saudi capital, Riyadh, military spokesperson Yahya Saree said Sunday. Saree also claimed that two drones struck pumping stations 5 and 6 along Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline in the Riyadh region. He said both operations successfully hit their targets. The claims have not been independently verified.
* **Ansarallah releases 600 detainees in Sana 'a, bringing unilateral releases to 2,612: **Ansarallah [unilaterally released](https://substack.com/redirect/b3f7d416-f5fb-490c-946b-5665fc71d747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 600 detainees in the capital, Sana'a, on Sunday, according to the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The organization said its delegates interviewed detainees privately before their release and provided assistance for their return home, but did not participate in selecting those freed. Abdul Qader al-Murtada, head of Ansarallah's National Committee for Prisoners' Affairs, said the latest release brought the total number of detainees unilaterally freed by the group since the war began to 2,612. Last month, the ICRC reported that Ansarallah had released another 159 detainees.
* **Armed men approach oil tanker east of Yemen 's Socotra island: **A tanker was approached by a suspicious ship and a small boat carrying four armed men approximately 430 nautical miles east of Yemen's Socotra island, the UK Maritime Trade Operations reported Monday. The tanker's captain reported seeing a ladder aboard the smaller vessel during the incident.

* **Israel strikes Syria-Lebanon border, claims weapons shipment destined for Hezbollah:** The Israeli military [said](https://substack.com/redirect/05bd8c85-f180-4f81-8c8c-00aeb3a8ac3a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday that it struck a weapons shipment allegedly destined for Hezbollah along the Syria-Lebanon border, accusing the Lebanese group of using areas across Lebanon for weapons smuggling and military activities. # U.S. News
* **Van Hollen accuses Schumer of attempting to rush Senate election:** Sen. **Chris Van Hollen** , the Maryland senator challenging Schumer for the job of majority leader, charged New York's Sen. **Chuck Schumer** with pushing for a "coronation," but told Politico he had the support to block any attempt to move the election to this week. Schumer's camp denied any such plan exists, emphasizing his confidence that he retains at least majority support inside the caucus and will be re-elected leader.
* Van Hollen**** addressed his challenge to Schumer on ABC's "This Week" on Sunday, saying that he thinks he has "a very open lane" in the race, and accusing Schumer's team of spreading "misinformation" and trying to "instill fear" in senators who may back him. He argued that midterm voters rejected Trump's policies, wars, corruption, and costs but "haven't fully hired the Democrats," so "going back to business as usual and status quo" won't earn their trust. Schumer has said he has the votes to continue serving as Democratic leader.
* **Senate permitting reform, energy bill headed for final passage:** The so-called Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act is undergoing final negotiations as environmental lawyers push to add ways to challenge energy projects and tribal advocates look to tighten tribal participation provisions. The clean energy industry remains in lockstep support of the bill, as does the fossil fuel industry.
* **U.S. loses measles elimination status:** The U.S. [lost](https://substack.com/redirect/fb60c5fa-ddb1-44db-b7ce-af96ebb21f48?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its measles elimination status, an expert panel from the Pan American Health Organization announced last week. The organization made the widely expected decision after a three-day meeting in Washington, concluding the virus has been transmitted continuously for more than 12 months. The CDC counts 5,412 confirmed cases this year versus 2,289 in all of 2025, the highest since 1991's 9,643, with Pennsylvania's outbreak accounting for more than 1,500 cases and six deaths. These are likely undercounts. Vaccine skepticism accounts for much of this rise, with distrust in vaccines fueled by ranking officials, including Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Canada and the UK have also lost their status over the past year.
* **Alaska continues counting votes, with Peltola increasing her lead over Sullivan:** Democrat **Mary Peltola** now [leads](https://substack.com/redirect/65b4019e-a398-48a1-9052-c13020b2c682?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Alaska's Senate contest by nearly 4 points, more than 11,000 votes, after the latest batch of votes was counted and results were released on Saturday. She netted nearly 2,000 votes from the latest batch. Decision Desk HQ shows her at 49.8% with 91% counted, just shy of the majority she needs to avoid ranked-choice tabulation. Her campaign again declared victory, saying "there is no mathematical path for Sullivan to win," though no major outlet has called the race as of Monday. All votes must be reported by Nov. 18.
* Democrat **Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins** won the state's gubernatorial race, with the AP calling the race in his favor on Friday. Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, will replace Republican **Mike Dunleavy** , who is term-limited and has held the post since 2018. He described himself as a "man of the middle" who would work in a "bipartisan" fashion during the campaign and said he would pay special attention to "unsexy and non-glamorous" issues like wait times for state permits and government benefits like Medicaid. He will be the state's first Democratic governor since 2002.
* **Trump 's portfolio likely held $13 million to $62 million in Nvidia stock as of August, the Washington Post finds: **President Donald Trump, whose portfolio has logged tens of thousands of stock trades in his second term, [held](https://substack.com/redirect/5fdf690e-26da-474e-bba6-ab2231a692a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) between $13 and $62 million in Nvidia stock as of the end of August, according to a review of his financial disclosures from that month. The actual value range may have been higher, the Post noted, citing Nvidia's rising share price. During his second administration, Trump has given the company's leadership major concessions, allowing its former CEO **Jensen Huang** extraordinary access to his administration. The White House maintains that "the President does not pick or trade individual stocks" and that independent managers handle his portfolio. Nvidia reportedly donated $25 million to Trump's White House ballroom, which it says was "independent of business interests."
* **International student enrollment falls at U.S. colleges** : New international student enrollment at U.S. universities [fell](https://substack.com/redirect/4b1420de-7ed4-424a-a6ee-8a0d173bee45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 15% this fall after an 18% drop last year, according to a survey of more than 800 universities released by The Institute of International Education on Monday. The survey shows that total international enrollment is down 9%, following a 3% drop last year. The administration's trade war with China and immigration crackdown are likely causes for this decline, as are the budget cuts at major research universities.
* **Incoming Rep. Don Leonard backing Ayanna Pressley:** Ohio's **Don Leonard** , who made headlines by saying that he had been threatened by senior Democrats over his reluctance to back Hakeem Jeffries for speaker, appeared on Breaking Points Monday morning and said that he was leaning toward voting for **Ayanna Pressley** , who has not announced a campaign but has been drawing support regardless. The leadership election is scheduled for Wednesday, and Jeffries still has no official opponent.
* **Federal prosecutor accuses Warren of preparing "to target private individuals close to" Trump and orders her to preserve documents: **U.S**.** Attorney for the Southern District of Texas **Aaron Reitz** , a former chief of staff to Sen. **Ted Cruz**(R-Texas), [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/a01a7265-0a7b-48be-8b71-1e83b633b28f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday that Senator Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.), in line to chair the Senate Banking Committee, appears "eager to wield" the gavel "like a tomahawk, hunting for the scalps of President Trump's private associates," one of several barbed references made to Native Americans made in the letter, alluding to attacks made on Warren over her past claims of Native ancestry. He gave "formal notice" to preserve documents on oversight efforts, warning of "sanctions, adverse-inference instructions, or other penalties," and said he asked the same of Sens. **Richard Blumenthal** (D-Conn.) and **Elissa Slotkin**(D-Mich.).
* **Duffy declines to apologize for Friday 's nationwide ground stop: **A router being [repaired](https://substack.com/redirect/fbec9a50-7cc8-4dac-9456-f69d2adbb497?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by an FAA contractor in Arkansas overwhelmed the nation's aviation communication network, leading the agency to ground all flights on Friday. The delay stranded hundreds of thousands of travelers and caused thousands of cancellations through the weekend. Transportation Secretary**Sean Duffy** told NBC's "Meet the Press" on Sunday that Friday's nationwide ground stop "happened on my watch," but "I can't apologize for what was passed off to us." He told the program that operations should normalize by Monday, but that he can't guarantee it won't recur until an investigation is completed.

# Other International News
* **UAE remains major hub for gold smuggled from war zones despite new regulations** : The United Arab Emirates (UAE) remains a key trading hub for gold smuggled from war zones despite new regulations imposed on the Emirati government under international pressure, according to a new [report](https://substack.com/redirect/5f120e9f-471f-4d39-9ec2-4c9cd4e20168?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Swissaid.
* At least 591 tons of such illicit gold valued at $74 billion was imported into the UAE, mostly in 2024, the report found.
* Much of the smuggled gold was conflict-related and smuggled out of Africa--including Guinea, Mali, and Sudan--as well as other countries including Russia and Yemen.
* "The UAE remains by far the main destination for gold linked to armed conflicts in Africa. And it continues to be a major destination for gold exports from countries subject to international sanctions," the report said.
* Switzerland was the leading importer of gold from the UAE and does not appear to be scaling back its trade with Dubai. Between January and September 2026, more than 400 tons of Emirati gold were imported into Switzerland.
* **Saudi Arabia executes two men:** Saudi Arabia executed two men, Jawad Abdullah Qureiris and Fadel Hassan al-Safwani, on Saturday, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/58b2cc98-3e90-46f7-b713-97e55ea53a09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the European Saudi Organization for Human Rights (ESOHR).
* One of the charges against Qureiris concerned his participation in a 2011 protest in the eastern city of Qatif calling for civil rights and the release of detainees when he was just 16 years old. Safwani, who also took part in protests in Qatif and was tried on terrorism-related charges, EOSHR said.
* Both men were detained in 2020 and were among 210 people executed in Saudi Arabia so far this year, according to ESOHR.
* **Imran Khan details inhumane treatment, asks for urgent medical care in letter to justices:** Pakistan's former Prime Minister Imran Khan, imprisoned for more than three years, has [written](https://substack.com/redirect/a29e78e9-c418-459d-95c4-ad721cd7d9d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the chief justices of Pakistan's three top courts detailing inhuman treatment he has received in solitary confinement and asking for urgent medical care for himself and his wife, Bushra Bibi. Khan says he has been isolated for up to 22 hours daily since December 2025, denied regular family visits and access to lawyers, books, and television.
* In the letter delivered through his lawyer, Khan says he has lost 85 percent of the vision in his right eye and that dangerously high blood pressure has left him at risk of brain hemorrhage or cardiac arrest. He says Bushra Bibi faces permanent blindness if she does not get urgent surgery. Khan alleges that authorities ignored a Supreme Court order requiring hospitalization. "I will only remain able to prove my innocence if I stay alive," he wrote.
* Khan and his wife were sent to jail on various charges by the military-backed regime more than three years ago after his government was removed with American approval in April 2022. More recently, his three sisters were also jailed in September ahead of a planned opposition march. Noreen Niazi and Uzma Khan were released November 12, after 53 days without charge, while Aleema Khan remains in jail.
* **About 4.5 million people have returned to Sudan, UNHCR says:** Since 2024, about 4.5 million Sudanese have [returned](https://substack.com/redirect/08ac98cf-7430-4427-bc7c-da8125327983?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to their home country, according to a Monday report from the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights. The returnees are 51% male and 49% female, and 72% intend to go back to their area of origin. The largest numbers came from Egypt (943,000) and South Sudan (225,000).
* **Africa CDC says the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is still not under control:** The ongoing Ebola outbreak in central and Eastern Africa is "still not under control," the Director-General of the Africa Center for Disease Control, Jean Kaseya, [told](https://substack.com/redirect/4b408097-919b-4e80-a796-2968d475d279?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Reuters Sunday. "If we don't stop this outbreak now, it would be the worst Ebola outbreak that the world will have," he added. More than 11,200 cases and 5,500 deaths have been reported since May 15, with over 80% of new cases emerging outside contact lists. Only $1.3 billion of the $2.9 billion pledged by donors has been released for use, and some health workers haven't been paid for months. The recent outbreak is the second-largest and second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record.
* **Somaliland 's intelligence agency says it briefly detained five U.S. nationals it accused of threatening national security: **Five U.S. nationals were briefly detained in the breakaway republic of Somaliland, its intelligence agency [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/8a1c202e-fb81-498f-940a-602b213a0999?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) late Sunday, claiming it had monitored them since arrival and conducted a "lengthy investigation." The announcement provided no details regarding their identities or alleged actions. A source told Reuters that they work for Parallel Black, a company registered in Delaware less than two months ago, and a Nov. 4 letter seen by Reuters shows Somaliland's foreign minister invited them to conduct investment feasibility studies. The source also told the wire service those detained left the country on an Ethiopian Airlines flight Monday afternoon.
* **Ecuador 's President Noboa denies the U.S. has a military base near Guayaquil: **Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa [said](https://substack.com/redirect/1c63d73a-49e2-4427-83e1-4e22d3622a9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Sunday that U.S. personnel at Taura Air Base are there only for "temporary activities" under bilateral cooperation, and that "it's not an American base. It's an Ecuadorian base." He did not address the U.S. aircraft present at the site, nor did he respond to a journalist's request to visit the base. Last month, the AFP documented at least 20 U.S. military flights there from June to mid-October, as well as the installation of dozens of tents and infrastructure work. Ecuadorian air force commander Gen. Mauricio Salazar, who asked the armed forces to clarify the deployment's legality in a September letter, was removed and reassigned. Human Rights Watch calls the U.S.-Ecuador partnership "perilous," saying both governments have committed serious rights violations by framing their fight against organized crime as a war.
* **Guatemala declares state of emergency in its eastern provinces after lawmakers killed:** Guatemalan authorities [declared](https://substack.com/redirect/d04122b9-16a2-4ee9-9f7b-1e13a800afa7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a state of emergency in the eastern provinces of Zacapa and Izabal, a week after the shooting of a lawmaker Julio Cesar Portillo in Rio Hondo, who later died, and three police officers also killed in the attack. Authorities did not say who was responsible for the shooting. Last week, the U.S. State Department designated several crime groups operating in Zacapa as terrorist organizations, accusing them of ties to Mexican cartels.
* **Mexican journalist found dead in Guerrero:** The body of Eduardo Flores, a journalist who [covered](https://substack.com/redirect/c682290e-7568-4664-ad81-b32bdd140d33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) security, social issues, and missing persons, was found on the outskirts of Acapulco on Saturday, according to his employer, Enfoque Informativo. Guerrero authorities announced an investigation into the killing on Sunday. Article 19 has documented 181 journalist killings in Mexico since 2000, including six in the first seven months of 2026, and Reporters Without Borders ranked Mexico second-most dangerous for reporters last year after Gaza, with murders of journalists rarely solved.
* **Martine Moise, widow of Haiti 's assassinated president Jovenel Moise, registers as a presidential candidate: **Martine Moise [registered](https://substack.com/redirect/8e84a1ef-e048-4102-b78b-7ab072d5a238?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to run**** in Haiti's first presidential election in a decade, the country's electoral council website showed Sunday. She is one of 33 registered candidates, three of them women, including former presidents Michel Martelly and Jocelerme Privert, former prime minister Claude Joseph, and former foreign minister Dominique Dupuy. A first-round vote is set for July. Moise was wounded in the 2021 attack by Colombian mercenaries that killed her husband and is a key witness in the Miami case against dozens of suspects.

Photo by AFP via Getty Images. Monday, November 16, 2026 - Iran: Iran claims six-drone strike on U.S. radar system in Bahrain. U.S. deploys third aircraft carrier to Middle East. Six oil tankers struck mines, caught fire in Strait of Hormuz, Iran says. IRGC claims capture of eighth intact U.S. drone in Hormuz. Israel reportedly warns U.S. of Iranian drone plot targeting President Donald Trump; Tehran denounces "disinformation." Israeli forces detain 13 Palestinians in occupied West Bank raids. Palestinian prisoners suffer severe weight loss and scabies in Israeli prison. Australia, Canada, UK, and Italy demand Israel allow 150,000 tents into Gaza amid deadly winter storms. Guardian: Israeli uploaded millions of photos of Palestinians to Amazon's facial recognition platform. Palestinian lawmaker elected deputy speaker of Israeli Knesset. Ansarallah claims strikes on Riyadh airport, financial center, and Saudi oil pipeline. Ansarallah releases 600 detainees in Sana'a, bringing unilateral releases to 2,612. Armed men approach oil tanker east of Yemen's Socotra island. Lebanon: Israeli forces abduct two Lebanese brothers in Shebaa, strike southern Lebanon despite ceasefire.
